theme.title: Five on the Floor
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1974–75 Warriors win?
questions.note: 48 wins, before the Warriors took the title.

funFacts.text: The Bullets entered the Finals with far more regular-season wins than Golden State.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Golden State Warriors (48–34) played against the Eastern Conference champion Washington Bullets (60–22)

funFacts.text: The championship was Golden State's first since 1956, when the franchise played in Philadelphia.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: win their first championship since 1956, when the team was still based in Philadelphia

funFacts.text: Golden State traded future Hall of Famer Nate Thurmond to Chicago for young center Clifford Ray before the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they traded future Hall of Famer Nate Thurmond to the Chicago Bulls for young center Clifford Ray

questions.prompt: How many rebounds per game did Bam Adebayo average for the 2020 Heat?
questions.note: 10.2 rebounds a game while anchoring the paint.

funFacts.text: Bam joined Butler on Miami's 2020 All-Star contingent.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo were both selected into 2020 NBA All-Star Game

funFacts.text: His rim protection included 93 blocks in the regular season.

questions.prompt: Boston needed a record number of playoff games to win the 2008 title. How many?
questions.note: 26, then a record for a champion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics set an NBA record for most playoff games ever needed to win a championship, with 26

funFacts.text: Boston survived Game 7 showdowns with both Atlanta and Cleveland before finally reaching Detroit.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: managed to prevail in a pair of Game 7s on their home court

funFacts.text: The Celtics finally broke their postseason road-win drought against the Pistons in the Eastern finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Celtics would finally break their road woes in a six-game win against the perennial Eastern Conference powerhouse Detroit Pistons

funFacts.text: Coach Doc Rivers had played for a Knicks team that held the old postseason games-played record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Coach Doc Rivers played for the 1993–94 New York Knicks, which held the previous record

questions.prompt: How many points per game did Tony Parker score for the 2014 Spurs?
questions.note: 16.7 points per game as part of a deep team.

funFacts.text: Parker played nearly two thousand minutes across sixty-eight appearances.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tony Parker | PG | 68 | 68 | 1,997

funFacts.text: He dished out 388 assists in the regular season.
Parker's passing average stood at 5.7 assists per game.
